aggregation: Within each base task average standard and random equally; category averages all 12 base tasks equally.
notes: Official category summaries are preserved separately from recomputation using displayed per-task percentages.
VPP2 is exactly the requested VPP2 entry, not VPP2_preview.
Small differences between category summaries and per-task recomputation can arise from published decimal rounding.
The rollout gallery is not used as the success-rate denominator.
These are public reported results; model training data, tool access, and inference budgets are not normalized by this comparison.
Incomplete tasks have null full-task success rates; native partial counts are retained separately.
LinkMind aggregates task-specific registered configurations, not one common frozen commit.
Missing outcomes are not failures or zero rates.
Only originally unscored scenarios are supplemented; original failed outcomes and all costs are retained.
Historical push_T 50/50 is superseded in the current column; its record remains in the previous snapshot.

local_method.selection_scope: Latest registered full-suite outcomes per task; task-specific candidates and missing-only supplements recorded separately.
local_method.category_note: 完整类别均值留空；未评分、跳过和停止的配置不填零。
local_method.configuration_note: LinkMind 列汇总各任务最新登记评测，使用按任务记录的配置与冻结提交，并非同一提交的一次全类别测试。fold 保留衣物测量；push_T 使用平面测量与专用IK检查；吐司、挂杯和扫块采用各自已验证的工具配置。只补原未评分场景，原失败、中断与全部尝试成本保留；开发小样本不混入。
